services.name: Public OSINT Graph
services.description: Resolves one public name on Wikidata and returns a relationship graph from a fixed property list (instance of, country, headquarters, founder, chief executive, ownership, employer, education, membership, and similar), up to two hops. People include only notable public roles. If nothing matches, the graph is empty and reason explains why.

services.name: SEO Optimizer
services.description: Fetches a URL and returns an on-page SEO score from real checks (title, meta, headings, alt text, keywords, and more). If the page cannot be fetched, returns an error status (403/404/5xx), is a CDN/WAF challenge page, or times out (7 s cap), it answers 422 with score null, the reason, and charged:false; no payment is taken.

services.name: SEO Optimizer v2
services.description: On-page SEO + AEO audit with paste-ready fixes: 0-100 score across technical, content, metadata, structured data and AI-answer readiness, ~25 checks with severity, and generated title/meta, canonical, Open Graph/Twitter and a JSON-LD skeleton. Scores reflect technical checks only; no ranking or citation is guaranteed. Not charged if the site blocks us or is unreachable (422, charged:false).

services.name: SEO Compare
services.description: Runs SEO Optimizer v2 on your page and up to 3 competitor pages and returns a per-check gap table. Not charged if your page blocks us or is unreachable (422, charged:false).

services.name: Agent-Ready Audit
services.description: Audits how ~17 AI crawlers and agents (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, ChatGPT-User, ...) can reach and read a site: robots rules per bot, live user-agent probes, llms.txt, sitemap, JSON-LD, canonical host, agent interfaces. Does not guarantee crawling, ranking, citation, or traffic. Not charged if the site blocks us or is unreachable (422, charged:false).

services.name: Agent-Ready Website Kit
services.description: Agent-Ready Audit plus generated files: llms.txt, llms-full.txt, merged robots.txt AI section, sitemap.xml, JSON-LD and meta/OG per page, agent card, and an install guide (zip). Unknown facts stay TODO. Kit license: No-Resale License (LICENSE.md in the zip; https://grokzilla.shop/kits/license). Not charged if the site blocks us or is unreachable (422, charged:false).

services.name: Agent-Ready Recheck
services.description: Re-runs an Agent-Ready audit from its report_id (30 days) and returns what got fixed or regressed. Not charged if the site blocks us or is unreachable (422, charged:false).

services.name: AI Content Detector
services.description: Estimate whether text (or a web page's text) is AI-written using a trained classifier: about 78% accurate on a held-out benchmark (not a guarantee). Uncertain results suggest a rerun on a longer section (300+ words); tell phrases are only a secondary 'possible AI influence' signal.

services.name: JSON Flattener
services.description: Deterministic nested JSON to flat path-value map. Arrays, custom separators, depth limits.

services.name: JSON Key Sorter
services.description: Recursively sort object keys and return canonical compact JSON. Deterministic, no network.

services.name: Text Diff
services.description: Lightweight deterministic line/word/char diff. Structured ops plus a one-line delta summary.

services.name: URL Normalizer
services.description: Canonicalize URLs: strip tracking params, force HTTPS, sort query, extract components.

services.name: HTML Cleaner
services.description: Strip scripts/styles and return readable text or markdown from HTML. mode normalized: text with NFKC and zero-width/bidi characters stripped.

services.name: JSON Schema Validator
services.description: Cheap schema gate: type, required, properties, array items, plus format checks (email, date, date-time, uri, ipv4, ipv6, uuid, hostname).

services.name: Keyword Extractor
services.description: Deterministic term ranking from free text. Stopword-filtered. ngrams 2-3 adds scored multi-word phrases.

services.name: Token Counter
services.description: Approximate cl100k/o200k token counts for budget decisions.

services.name: SHA-256 Hash
services.description: Hash a string (SHA-256 by default; algo: sha512, sha3_256 or blake2b_256) and return hex plus a short prefix. Deterministic, no network.

services.name: UUID Minter
services.description: Mint 1-32 IDs for agent job IDs and idempotency keys: UUID v4 (default), v7 or v1 (time-ordered), or ULID (format: ulid). v7 and ULID batches sort in mint order.

services.name: Slugify
services.description: Turn free text into a URL-safe lowercase slug. Deterministic, no network.

services.name: PII Redactor
services.description: Redact emails, phone numbers, SSN-shaped strings, Luhn-valid card numbers and IPv4 addresses with typed placeholders. Deterministic, no network.

services.name: CSV Normalizer
services.description: Parse CSV into JSON rows keyed by trimmed snake_case headers, plus a type hint per column (integer, number, boolean, date, datetime, string). Deterministic, no network.

services.name: Base64 Encode/Decode
services.description: Encode UTF-8 text or decode it back: base64 (default; standard or URL-safe), base32, base58 (Bitcoin alphabet), hex or URI percent-encoding (codec). Deterministic, no network.

services.name: Epoch Converter
services.description: Convert epoch seconds or milliseconds (detected by magnitude) or an ISO-8601 string into epoch_s, epoch_ms, UTC ISO and ISO in any IANA time zone. Deterministic, no network.

services.name: URL to Markdown
services.description: Fetch one public web page and return its title and clean Markdown (headings, links, lists, code, tables). Honors robots.txt, SSRF-guarded, HTML only, 1 MB / 5 s caps. No JavaScript rendering.

services.name: Token Risk (Base)
services.description: Heuristic risk checks for a Base ERC-20: contract code, metadata, proxy, owner/renounced, mint/blacklist/pause/fee selectors, deepest Uniswap/Aerodrome pool, and simulated sell/buy transfers with measured tax. Read-only public RPC. Not financial advice.

services.name: JSON Repair
services.description: Repair malformed or truncated JSON from LLMs, JS or Python: strips ```json fences and comments, fixes trailing commas, single quotes, unquoted keys, True/False/None, missing commas and unclosed strings/brackets. Returns the parsed JSON, a compact repaired JSON string and the list of fixes. Deterministic, no network.

services.name: Cron Next Runs
services.description: Validate a 5-field cron expression (lists, ranges, steps, JAN-DEC/SUN-SAT names, @daily/@hourly macros) and return its next 1-20 run times in any IANA time zone (DST-aware), as local ISO, UTC ISO and epoch seconds. Deterministic, no network.

services.name: Verified Token Price (Base)
services.description: Verified USD price for a Base ERC-20: DeFiLlama cross-checked against the deepest on-chain Uniswap/Aerodrome pool. Returns price, spread, staleness, confidence. Refused, not charged, if sources disagree over 2.5% or one is missing. Data only, not investment advice.

services.name: Email Deliverability Check
services.description: Check an email address for deliverability: syntax, canonical form, MX, SPF, DMARC, disposable domain. One verdict with reasons and sources. DNS-over-HTTPS only, no mailbox probing. Not charged if the DNS lookup fails.

services.name: News Brief with Sources
services.description: Topic in, deduplicated story clusters out: headline, every outlet URL and first-seen time, from GDELT and publisher RSS. Headlines and links only, no article text. Not charged when nothing matches or sources fail.

services.name: IP & CIDR Intel
services.description: One public IP or CIDR in: normalized network, size, membership checks, plus holder, abuse contact and origin ASN from RIR RDAP and RIPEstat, and country from DB-IP Lite (CC BY 4.0, attributed). Private ranges refused before payment. Not charged if registries fail.

services.name: LLM Cost Quote
services.description: Text or token counts in, cost per model out, cheapest first, from OpenRouter's public price list with a price-fetched-at timestamp. Applies time-of-day pricing. Not charged if the price list is unavailable or no model matches.

services.name: Address Validate
services.description: Validate an EVM, Solana, or Bitcoin address locally (EIP-55 checksum, base58, bech32). Optional eth_getCode on Base to label eoa vs contract. No RPC required by default.

services.name: Gas Price
services.description: EIP-1559 base fee and priority fee percentiles (p25/p50/p90) for Base and/or Ethereum via eth_feeHistory. Cached 10s. Optional eth-transfer USD estimate on Base.

services.name: ERC-20 Metadata
services.description: Read ERC-20 name, symbol, decimals, totalSupply (and optional holder balanceOf) via multicall3 on Base or Ethereum. 400 if the address is not a contract.

services.name: DNS Lookup
services.description: DNS-over-HTTPS lookup (A/AAAA/MX/TXT/NS/CNAME/CAA) via Google Public DNS with Cloudflare fallback. Rejects IP literals and private names.

services.name: Name Resolve (ENS + Basename)
services.description: Resolve ENS (.eth) on Ethereum and Basenames (.base.eth) on Base, forward or reverse. Returns address, name, source, forward_verified, optional avatar.

services.name: TX Status
services.description: Transaction receipt status, block, and confirmations on Base or Ethereum via eth_getTransactionReceipt. Validates 0x tx hash before payment. Short-cached.

services.name: Hex Decode
services.description: Local-only hex decode to utf-8, bytes32, address, and 4-byte selector note. No network fetch (no 4byte.directory).

services.name: Block Number
services.description: Latest eth_blockNumber for Base and/or Ethereum, optional block timestamp. Cached ~2s.

services.name: WHOIS / RDAP
services.description: Domain registration lookup via IANA RDAP DNS bootstrap only (registrar, status, nameservers, events). Rejects IP literals and private names. Rate-limited, ~5s timeout, SSRF-safe (no private redirects).

partner_resale.description: Resold partner services (provider x402-mcp.onrender.com, not ours). GET with query params, paid per call via x402 on Base. Your payment settles first; if the partner then fails you get charged:true plus a full refund record. Output is normalized to grokzilla.partner-resale.v1. Separate from the native skills list.

kits.description: One-time downloadable kits, paid per purchase via x402. License: No-Resale (/kits/license).

kits.name: Domain-to-Vercel MCP kit (bring your own keys)
kits.description: Two local MCP servers that point a GoDaddy domain at a Vercel project in one call: execute_task("{connect_domain; example.com}") sets A @ + CNAME www, adds the domain to your Vercel project and reads the records back. Runs on your machine with your own GoDaddy and Vercel keys; nothing is hosted and we never see your keys.

credit_packs.description: Prepaid call packs, one x402 payment each. Outside the per-call skills list; buy only on purpose.

packs.name: Credit pack (300 calls)
packs.description: Credit pack: 300 calls of any skill listed at $0.005 or less, for one $1.00 x402 payment. Returns a token (shown once) for the X-Credit-Token header. Failed calls use no credit. Expires after 180 days.
